2608.15270.title: Time as Structure: Temporal Dependency Graphs for Verifiable Deadline Computation over Legal Documents
2608.15270.paper_summary: Miss a filing deadline by one day and the claim is barred, however strong the case. Computing that deadline is rarely simple: the period runs from a triggering event, is counted by a statutory convention, and may be suspended by a mandatory conciliation window. We ask whether a language model should answer such questions directly, or read the document and leave the arithmetic to code. We extract dated facts and their dependencies into a temporal dependency graph and compute deadlines from it with a calendar-correct engine. On UK Employment Appeal Tribunal judgments the engine reproduces six of seven timeliness rulings, and matches the judges' own dates to the day. The strongest of four language models, asked the same cases, gets the arithmetic right and the answer wrong: in six of twenty-one responses its stated verdict contradicts its own thinking, and every contradiction runs the same way, calling a late claim timely. To test the systems at scale we move the dismissal date across the statutory boundary, generating 427 cases whose answers are computed rather than annotated. On the cases both systems answer, the pipeline is right 90.2% of the time against 61.2% for direct answering. The limit is extraction: on contracts the errors are almost never in the arithmetic, but in choosing which event the period starts from.
2608.15270.paper_summary_zh: 錯過申請截止日期一天，該申請將被禁止，無論案件多麼強有力。計算截止日期通常不簡單：期限從觸發事件開始，依據法定慣例進行計算，並可能因強制調解窗口而暫停。我們詢問語言模型是否應該直接回答這類問題，或是閱讀文件並將算術運算留給程式碼。我們將有日期的事實及其依賴關係提取到時間依賴圖中，並使用日曆正確的引擎計算截止日期。在英國就業上訴法庭的判決中，該引擎重現了七個及格時效裁決中的六個，並將法官的日期精確到天。四個語言模型中最強的那一個，在被詢問相同案件時，算術運算正確但答案錯誤：在二十一個回應中，有六個所陳述的裁決與其自身的思考相矛盾，且每一個矛盾都是同樣的方式，將遲交的申請稱為及時的。為了在大規模上測試這些系統，我們將解僱日期移動到法定邊界，生成427個案例，其答案是計算得出的，而不是註解的。在兩個系統都回答的案例中，該流程的正確率為90.2%，而直接回答的正確率為61.2%。限制在於提取：在合同中，錯誤幾乎從不出現在算術運算中，而是在選擇期限開始的事件上。
